+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_domain_counts(params: dict | None = None) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    """Return the number of users for each lowercase email domain.
+
+    The ``params`` argument is accepted for handler uniformity and ignored.
+    """
+    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
+    for user in users.list_users():
+        domain = user["email"].rsplit("@", 1)[-1].lower()
+        counts[domain] = counts.get(domain, 0) + 1
+    return 200, {"domains": counts}

--- a/tests/test_domain_counts.py
+++ b/tests/test_domain_counts.py
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+import app.api.handlers as handlers
+from app.api.handlers import handle_domain_counts
+from app.db import store
+
+
+def test_domain_counts_returns_domains_for_all_users():
+    status, body = handle_domain_counts({})
+
+    assert status == 200
+    assert set(body) == {"domains"}
+
+    expected: dict[str, int] = {}
+    for user in store.list_all():
+        domain = user["email"].rsplit("@", 1)[-1].lower()
+        expected[domain] = expected.get(domain, 0) + 1
+
+    assert body["domains"] == expected
+    # The store is seeded with three users, all at example.com.
+    assert body["domains"]["example.com"] >= 3
+
+
+def test_domain_counts_ignores_params():
+    assert handle_domain_counts({"id": "1", "unexpected": True}) == handle_domain_counts({})
+
+
+def test_domain_counts_lowercases_domain_and_counts(monkeypatch):
+    fake_users = [
+        {"id": 1, "name": "A", "email": "ada@Example.COM"},
+        {"id": 2, "name": "B", "email": "linus@example.com"},
+        {"id": 3, "name": "C", "email": "grace@other.org"},
+    ]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(handlers.users, "list_users", lambda: fake_users)
+
+    assert handle_domain_counts({}) == (200, {"domains": {"example.com": 2, "other.org": 1}})
